description: Documentation for the Mouse class in Playwright API, detailing its purpose, usage examples in various programming languages, and available methods.

classes.name: Mouse
classes.description: Represents the mouse input device for automating mouse actions within a page.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Dispatches a mousemove event at specified coordinates with optional steps for smooth movement.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Dispatches a mousedown event at given coordinates.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Dispatches a mouseup event at given coordinates.

methods.name: click
methods.description: A shortcut for move, down, and up events to simulate a mouse click.

methods.name: dblclick
methods.description: A shortcut for double click actions such as move, down, up, down, and up.

methods.name: wheel
methods.description: Dispatches a wheel event for scrolling actions.
